newsitem.title: USA: Corporate Renaissance sets share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Corporate Renaissance sets share buyback.

text.p: Corporate Renaissance Group Inc said Tuesday that it will repurchase up to 175,000 shares of its common stock, representing 18.3 percent of its outstanding shares, in open-market transactions, but based on current market conditions, its board will not act on a self-tender offer that had been approved in principle on August 7.

The company said its board approved the buyback to give stockholders more market liquidity and said the buyback of its shares at a discount from net asset value should enhance long-term shareholder value.
